comparison.objective: Apply an opaque primer coat to a steel plate without drips.
comparison.physical_skill: Brush loading, rim wiping, compliant stroke control, coverage planning, and drip avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: At least 95% opaque coverage with no prohibited bench brushing and at most one drip; full credit also requires putting down and releasing the brush.
comparison.reason: Tests distributed surface coating with fluid-load management, not localized impact fracture, retained-thread-insert preservation, or loose-fragment recovery.
